verdict.rationale: RustDesk offers a management API in Server Pro, so a sandbox or test environment for exercising it is a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence documents a sandbox, test tenant, or dry-run mode isolated from production data. Self-hosting a separate server is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
